verseText: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
meaning: We are blessed and truly happy when we have a fearful respect of God's power and live life God's way.

recall.question: Who does this verse say is blessed?
choices: Those who fear the LORD and walk in His ways

meaning.question: To “fear the LORD” means to honor Him with deep respect. What does it mean to “walk in His ways”?
choices: Live by what He teaches us
To only do what He says on Sundays

application.prompt: God doesn't give us rules to spoil our fun. His commands are the best way to live in the world that He made for us. Think of a time when following His way feels difficult. How could trusting that His way is good help you choose to obey Him?
